claims.text: A 36-year-old Sudanese male proband had hypohidrosis, hypotrichosis and hypodontia, with recurrent hyperthermia in hot weather, light and dry scalp hair, prominent ears, protruding lips, ichthyosis on the legs, dry skin and sole hyperkeratosis. Symptoms were present since birth; a dental evaluation in 2012 raised clinical suspicion of hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia, and molecular testing was performed in 2014 after referral to a genetic center.
